_provenance: System/event ledger. Events carry a timestamp and an epoch is assigned to each drive by timestamp order. Avoids repeating constants (tyre set, ECU) on every drive. ECU/firmware treated as one unknown-but-unchanged epoch until an explicit event is supplied. Populate tyre/service events as timestamped records become available.

events.detail: ECU/firmware unknown; treated as single unchanged epoch until an explicit change event exists
Baseline tyre epoch. Replace/extend when a timestamped tyre-set change is supplied; do not duplicate on every drive.

epochAssignmentRule: For each drive, the active epoch of a given event-type is the most recent event of that type with timestamp <= drive local start. Drives before the first event of a type get epoch 'unknown'.
pidEpochRule: pid_schema_epoch and raw_schema_hash are generated by normalising each raw CSV header (staged in the raw-pass stage). Distinct header signatures -> distinct pid_schema_epoch. Missing channels remain missing, never physical zero.
